messages:
maria: Heads up — prepping Python + TS SDK publish this afternoon. CI surfaced a cross-language telemetry export change that could break downstream ingestion. I'm going to hold the publish until we confirm a rollback/compat plan.
ash: Thanks for flagging. Which package is affected? can we pin the current dist-tags to prevent accidental GA? :eyes:
maria: It's the telemetry client shim — python sdk 1.4.2 / ts sdk 2.0.0-rc. The tests failing are in integrations (not unit). I already removed the GA dist-tag locally, but we should make it explicit.
deploy-bot: Automated check: publish pipeline queued for 3245680000. To cancel run: `/deploy cancel 3245680000`
ash: @deploy-bot cancel please (also @maria can you paste the exact npm/pypi commands so release ops can run them?)
maria: npm: `npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk-js@1.3.9 stable` then `npm dist-tag rm @redwood/sdk-js 2.0.0-rc --no-git`
python: `twine upload --repository-url https://upload.pypi.org/legacy/ dist/*` (we're not running that until QA green)
jordan: For the release notes / deprecation copy: if we pin back, we should add a short blurb about telemetry schema change and migration steps. I'll draft and post to the release-notes doc.
kai: Can we add a quick compatibility shim in TS that reads both old/new payload shapes? If it's trivial we can hotpatch and republish the rc with a patch.
sam_ts: Quick check: if we republish a patched RC, we MUST update the canary tag and call out the changelog so downstream SDK consumers on TS can opt-in. Also update the internal model serving routing that relies on telemetry version header.
ash: Ops plan options: (A) revert to previous dist-tags and delay release until Monday, (B) publish a patch RC with shim + tests and run a limited canary to internal teams, (C) emergency rollback after publish (yuck). Thoughts?
maria: Prefer B if the shim is <= 2hrs dev + 30m QA. If not, A. No one wants C.
ash: @kai can you spike the shim? If ready, ping me and I'll trigger a canary against staging only.
kai: On it. Will post status in 45m.
ash: I'll update the release checklist: remove automatic cut until we get a green from the canary. tagging plan: keep current stable tags as-is, set a hold flag in the deploy pipeline.
deploy-bot: Pipeline status: hold placed on publish pipeline 3245680000 by ash.
devex-oncall: Noted. If this becomes a multi-hour hold, we should notify partner teams (support/sales) with the short blurb. I can send the heads-up once we have the final decision.
jordan: Drafted release-note snippet: "Postponed SDK GA due to telemetry schema change. We are shipping a compatibility patch; please follow the migration guide." Sharing doc: https://docs.internal/release-notes/drafts/sdk-telemetry-compat (edit access: devex)
maria: Thanks all — I'll keep this thread updated. If kai's shim looks small we go for canary B, otherwise we move to A and reschedule the publish to next Tue morning.
kai: Shim ready in branch `telemetry/compat-shim`, tests added. Pushing a canary build now.
ash: Received canary results: staging traffic ran 30m, no ingestion errors in the telemetry pipeline. Ash -> approve canary? :white_check_mark:
maria: Approving. Ash please flip the hold to allow canary -> limited GA. Also let's add a one-line migration snippet in the top-level README so support can triage quickly.
ash: Will do. I'll also add a short deprecation note for old shape that we keep for two minor versions.
deploy-bot: Hold removed by ash. Publish pipeline resumed at 3245680500.
maria: Follow-up: created a support playbook and updated release-notes draft. Link: https://docs.internal/release-notes/sdk-telemetry-compat-v1 (please review) :shipit:
